overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed and amended a draft Request for Proposals (RFP) to hire a new consultant for the city’s multi-year zoning update project. The committee authorized the Planning Department to proceed with the procurement process after incorporating edits regarding design standards, meeting frequency, and selection transparency.

items.title: Zoning Update Project RFP Presentation
items.summary: Director of Planning and Development Alicia Hunt presented a draft RFP for a new zoning consultant, detailing a qualifications-based procurement process and a timeline targeting a February 2027 start date.

items.title: Selection Committee and Decision-Making
items.summary: The committee discussed the composition of the review team and requested that finalists be presented to the City Council and Community Development Board for public review before a final selection is made.

items.title: Design Standards and Guidelines
items.summary: Councilors debated the inclusion of design standards, ultimately amending the scope to ensure any proposed standards consider project feasibility and allow for building material flexibility.

items.title: Public Engagement and Meeting Frequency
items.summary: The committee reviewed the proposed meeting schedule and modified the language to allow consultants to propose their own effective public engagement strategies based on professional experience.

items.title: Technical RFP Edits and Data Ownership
items.summary: Councilors discussed technical requirements including contract duration, GIS data ownership, and the reduction of hard copy requirements to three sets.

items.title: Authorization to Proceed
items.summary: Approved a motion to authorize the Planning Director to move forward with the RFP process incorporating the feedback and amendments discussed during the meeting.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Residents provided feedback supporting flexible design guidelines over rigid standards and encouraged the use of joint meetings to maintain consistency between boards.

subject: Zoning Update Project RFP
